Największe ryzyko polega na ograniczeniu: The biggest risk lies in limiting your choice. If you decide solely by location, you may overlook an agency with a better portfolio, a stronger team, experience in your industry or a better delivery process.

That's why location can't replace verifying the scope, the contract and responsibility.

Przy większym projekcie potrzebne są też: A bigger project also needs UX, SEO, analytics, copywriting, development and technical care.

Wzrost firmy szybko odsłania braki w tec: Company growth quickly reveals gaps in technology, SEO and integrations. A simple business card website can over time turn into a website that needs development, analytics, integrations with a CRM, forms, payments or a store.
